title: NBN POI 2MYF (Mayfield) Splice Relocation
current_summary: Planned works at the NBN Mayfield (2MYF) POI are complete. Customers with NBN services connected via this POI in NSW may have experienced interruptions between 12:00 AM and 7:00 AM AEST on 10 August 2026. Services are now operating normally and we are monitoring.

updates.content: Planned works at the NBN Mayfield (2MYF) Point of Interconnect have finished. Some NBN services connected via this POI may have been interrupted during the 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM AEST window on 10 August 2026. Services are now operating normally and we are monitoring. Thank you for your patience.
